title: TD Talk: bug and reply voice alerts, microphone asked once, deleted messages disappear
text: In #td-bug a new bug now plays the recorded voice "New TD bug", and a reply says "New TD bug reply" (or "New reply" in other channels). A deleted message now disappears instead of showing "This message was deleted". Recording a voice note is built to ask for the microphone only once, keeps the screen awake while you record, and keeps what was recorded if the phone ends the recording early.
points: The microphone is let go after 3 minutes without recording or when the app goes to the background, then asked for again.
A blocked microphone now shows a plain message with the iPhone Settings steps.
